facts.fact: Meera hides the seal in the third stack of the woodpile behind Nimmi's goat shed, in a gap between two deodar rounds covered with loose bark and a walnut billet. The reader is shown this; Rohan is not told.
A high goat track over the shoulder above the walnut terraces runs to Garh Neshar, well away from the lower road; Meera proposes it and Rohan declines to flee by it.
Rohan names the cost of staying: he may miss the Fair and lose his writ to the warrant, but a hidden seal outlives his arrest.
